Kotlin Multiplatform native D-Bus project: `src/commonMain/kotlin` shared API/serialization; `src/nativeMain/kotlin` + `src/nativeInterop/cinterop` Linux/interop; `src/nativeTest/kotlin/{unit,integration,mocks}` tests; `codegen/` JVM XML-to-Kotlin CLI/library; `plugin/` Gradle plugin `com.monkopedia.sdbus.plugin` on `:codegen`; `compile_test/` dependency wiring; `samples/bluez-scan/` consumer.

Use Gradle wrapper from repo root:
`./gradlew build` full build; `./gradlew test` JVM/native tests; `./gradlew ktlintCheck` style; `./gradlew licenseCheck` license headers/required checks; `./gradlew dokkaHtml` docs in `build/dokka`; `./gradlew codegen:fatJar` release JAR. CI release/docs: `gradle publish codegen:fatJar`, `gradle dokkaHtml` on Ubuntu.

Follow `.editorconfig`: 4 spaces, LF, max 100; `ktlint` (`android_studio`); `UpperCamelCase` classes, `lowerCamelCase` functions/properties, packages under `com.monkopedia.sdbus`. Keep public API changes intentional; binary compatibility validation (`apiValidation`). Tests: `src/nativeTest`, `codegen/src/test/kotlin`, `plugin`; descriptive names (e.g. `createsProxyFromXml`). Run `./gradlew test` before PRs; include integration coverage for tra
